readerCopy.body: Difficult experience can become unexpectedly useful when a larger opportunity has somewhere concrete to use what was learned. When Jupiter sextiles Chiron, expansion and sensitivity cooperate through mentorship, teaching, publication, a new role, or access that gives hard-earned knowledge a practical use. The experience does not have to be reframed as a gift. Its value is that what was learned can now improve judgment, qualification, or support in a new context.
